//: Registry entries (by id) that console-render-smoke.yml installs and renders in a live kubestellar/console build. Add ids to grow coverage; each must exist in registry.json under the matching type.
//dashboard: All three dashboard presets; every card_type they reference is registered in console's pinned cardRegistry/card-registry-manifest.json.
//card-preset: Every card-preset whose card_type is confirmed present in console's pinned card-registry-manifest.json (same check scripts/validate_marketplace_lib/checks_console.py's check_card_type_existence() does: console-registered first, `*_status` suffix treated as a CNCF dynamic-card placeholder only when NOT registered). A `*_status` suffix alone does NOT mean unregistered: see #1064. Excluded are only (a) marketplace-side `_placeholder: true` presets awaiting implementation and (b) card_types genuinely absent from console's registry (e.g. kubeflow_status, see #1008's revert) — those can only be covered by marketplace's own vitest suite, not here.
